decision.observation: 11:00 am; the bobber and line are gone from the pond after the reel-in; the farmer stands above the pond's north rim, facing down, with the bamboo pole selected.
decision.hypothesis: Holding C while facing south will cast the bobber back into the pond; a subsequent dip cue pressed with C may yield a catch (the Broken Glasses came from a dip press).
decision.memory: Fishing loop: face water, hold C to cast, press C at bobber dips (sometimes catches directly, sometimes a nibble that reels in); if the bar minigame opens, LMB holds/releases keep the green bar on the fish. Catches: Sunfish, Joja Cola x2, Broken Glasses. Ship via the porch bin.
